name: core-runtime-userprovisioning-deterministic-wave19
notes: Wave19 deterministic local-only witness for substantive UserProvisioning runtime behavior. Hosted provisioning parity is not claimed.
salesforceExclusionReason: UserProvisioning requires local deterministic mocks; this fixture proves local runtime behavior only and makes no hosted provisioning claim.

source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeUserProvisioningWave19Test { @isTest static void userProvisioningRuntimeWitness() { UserProvisioning.CollectingBatchable c = new UserProvisioning.CollectingBatchable('0','upr','app'); c.nextReconOffset = 'next'; c.reconOffset = 'offset'; c.status = 'Queued'; System.assertEquals('next', c.nextReconOffset); System.assertEquals('offset', c.reconOffset); System.assertEquals('Queued', c.status); } }
